t: Melakot hammuttarim vehaasurim lehatchil beereb shabbat kede sheyyihyu nigmarim beshabbat
s: Melakot hammuttarim vehaasurim lehatchil beereb shabbat kede sheyyihyu nigmarim beshabbat ubo k' seipim: muttar lehatchil bimlaka beereb shabbat samuk lachasheka, ap al pi sheeno yakol legomrah mibbeod yom, vehi nigmeret meeleha beshabbat, kegon lishrot deyo vesamemanim bammayim. Veken litten hasseorim bammayim begigit samuk lachasheka, vehem nishrim sham kol hashshabbat kullah. Veken litten mugmar tachat habbegadim al gabbe gechalim samuk lachasheka, vehem mitgammerim veholekim kol hashshabbat kullah, apillu im hammugmar vehaggechalim munnachim bikli, sheap shehammelaka naaset beshabbat bikli shel yisrael — en bekak kelum, sheen adam metzuvveh al shebitat kelayv shello teaseh bahen melaka beshabbat meeleha, apillu im hu beinyan shehakkeli beatzmo hu haoseh melaka beshabbat meelayv, kegon lipros metzudot chayya veopot vedagim mibbeod yom vehem nitztzodim beshabbat, ap al pi shehammetzuda hi haosa maaseh hatztzeda beshabbat, shehappach niqshar vetopes haop, veken hayyaqush shepposhetim lechayyot lelokdan beraglehen keshehem nogeim bo, qopetz umitchabber meelayv veloked:

Veken muttar latet tzemer letok hayyora mibbeod yom [le]tzobo, vehu mitztabbea meelayv kol hashshabbat kullah. Vehu shettehe hayyora aqura meal haesh kol hashshabbat kullah, sheim omedet al haesh — asur mishshum gezera shemma yishkach veyachteh begechalim beshabbat lemaher bishshul samemane hatztzeba. Vegam shettehe hayyora tucha betit sebib kissuyah, sheim enah tucha — asur, mishshum shemma yishkach vigalleh kissuyah beshabbat ve[ya]gis bah bekap, vehammegis biqdera rotachat apillu enah al haesh — chayyab mishshum mebashshel, shehahagasa goremet lemaher habbishshul. Vaapillu im samemane hatztzeba nitbashshelu kebar kol tzorkan mibbeod yom , mikkol maqom keshemmegis bahen beshabbat — chayyab mishshum tzobea, sheal yede hahagasa niqlat hatztzeba batztzemer, abal keshehi tucha betit — lo yabo litroach kol kak listor hattichuy kede lehagis. Abal muttar latet unin (perush matveh) shel pishtan letok hattannur mibbeod yom kede sheyyitlabbenu sham kol hashshabbat kullah, ap al pi sheen pi hattannur tuach betit sebib kissuyo, dekevan sheharuach qasheh lehaunin — lo yabo legallot kissuy hattannur kede lachtot begechalim shebbeshulayv:

Muttar limkor lenokri ulehatino hammiqqach samuk lachasheka, ubilbad sheyyetze mippetach beto im hammiqqach mibbeod yom, apillu hi ir hamorebet, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"v. Vaapillu im yiched lehannokri cheder bachatzero sheyyanniach sham miqqacho qodem hashshabbat, veachar kak beshabbat ba hannokri littelo mishsham leholiko lebeto — lo yannichennu leholiko ad leachar hashshabbat, ella im ken shehannokri alim vehu mityare mimmennu, sheaz yesh lehaqel ap im lo yiched lo maqom lemiqqacho qodem hashshabbat:

Umuttar litten begadayv lekobes nokri veorot leabbedan nokri samuk lachasheka beqabbelanut, vehannokri oseh meatzmo apillu beshabbat, ubilbad shehayyisrael lo yomar lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat. Veken lo yomar lo "reeh shettiggamer hammelaka beyom a', o beyom b'", veyadua shei epshar legomrah az ella im ken sheyyaaseh gam beshabbat, shehare zeh keillu omer lo beperush laasot beshabbat. Abal keshello amar lo kelum vehannokri oseh beshabbat meatzmo — eno tzarik limchot beyado, lepi sheen hannokri mitkavven baasiyyato beshabbat bishbil hayyisrael, shehare ap im lo haya oseh ad leachar hashshabbat haya meqayyem tzivvuy hayyisrael, kevan shehayyisrael lo gilla lo dato laasot beshabbat, ella hu oseh beshabbat leatzmo kede lehashlim qabbelanuto, sheim lo yaaseh hayyom yitztarek laasot lemachar, veakshav sheasa hayyom yihyeh panuy lemachar:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehannokri oseh beshabbat bebeto, o bebayit acher sheeno reshut yisrael, sheaz en haddabar nikkar shehi meleket yisrael, abal asur lehannicho laasot birshut yisrael, lepi shekkesheoseh birshut yisrael nikkar haddabar shehi meleket hayyisrael, veshemma yachsheduhu shennatan lo beshabbat, o yachsheduhu shehannokri hu sekir yom etzlo velo qabbelan, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"d. Vaapillu keshehammelaka naaset bebet nokri — yesh omerim sheen hetter ella kesheen maggia revach leyisrael mimmah shehammelaka naaset beshabbat, sheap im yaasenna achar hashshabbat yehaneh mimmenna hayyisrael kak kemo akshav shehi naaset beshabbat, veap shehu chapetz yoter sheteaseh beshabbat kede shettiggamer miqqodem veyakol lehanot mimmenna miqqodem — (ve)en zeh niqra revach, kevan sheap im teaseh achar hashshabbat yehaneh gam ken mimmenna. Abal im hu beinyan sheim teaseh achar hashshabbat lo yukal lehanot mimmenna, veen lo bah chepetz kelal ella im ken teaseh beshabbat, kegon sheholek lederek miyyad bemotzae shabbat vekayyotze bazeh, beinyan sheyyesh revach leyisrael mimmah shehammelaka naaset beshabbat — asur littenah lehannokri qodem hashshabbat ella im ken sheyyukal legomrah bime hachol qodem hashshabbat o achar kak. Veap im netanah lo bikde sheyyakol legomrah qodem hashshabbat venoda lo shehannokri oseh beshabbat — tzarik limchot beyado, dekevan shellehayyisrael yesh revach mizzeh shehammelaka naaset akshav beshabbat, ulehannokri en revach mizzeh, shemmitztziddo lo yibbatzer laasotah achar hashshabbat, ella shehu oseh beshabbat lepi tummo lehashlim peullato, veen maggia lo revach mizzeh kemo shemmaggia lehayyisrael, lepikak nireh haddabar keillu bishbil zeh hayyisrael naaset hammelaka beshabbat. Veyesh mi shemmattir littenah lo samuk lachasheka vehu yaaseh meatzmo beshabbat bebeto, raq shello yegalleh lo dato shetztzarik lo shetteaseh beshabbat, velo yomar lo kelal sheyyotze lederek bemotzae shabbat miyyad. Veepshar sheenan choleqim kelal, shehammattir epshar shello hittir ella keshehu beinyan shekkeshello yaaseh beshabbat veachar hashshabbat lo yihyeh lehayyisrael kelal chepetz bimlakto — azay lo yeshallem lo hayyisrael bead melakto, venimtza shebbemah shehu oseh hammelaka beshabbat maggia lo revach sheyyeshallem lo hayyisrael bead melakto. Ubezeh epshar sheggam haoser modeh shehu muttar, dekevan sheggam lehannokri maggia revach mimmeleket hashshabbat — enah niret keillu hi naaset bishbil hayyisrael bilbad. Abal im hu beinyan sheap im lo yaaseh beshabbat yaaseh achar hashshabbat, veyitztarek hayyisrael leshallem lo, kevan shello hitna immo bitchilla al menat shettugmar hammelaka bemotzae shabbat miyyad, venimtza sheen maggia revach lehannokri mimmah sheoseh beshabbat ella lehayyisrael bilbad — epshar shebbezeh ap hammattir modeh shehu asur:

Vekol zeh kesheqqotzetz lo damim biskar melakto, sheaz hu toreach leatzmo kede leqabbel sekaro, veeno nireh keoseh shelichuto shel hayyisrael, o sheoseh betobat hanaa, dehaynu sheoseh bechinnam bishbil tobat hanaa sheqqibbel kebar mehayyisrael, veal derek shennitbaer besimman rm"z, sheddino keillu qatzatz lo sakar. Abal im en hannokri chapetz laasot bechinnam, ella metzappeh hu letashlum sakar, abal en dato semuka alayv bevadday, shello qatzatz lo hayyisrael sakar, venimtza shehu toreach besapeq bishbil hayyisrael, venireh keoseh shelichuto, lepikak lo yitten lo ella im ken sheyyakol legomrah qodem hashshabbat. Vedabar sheqqitzbato yadua, kegon kelim lekobes bizmannenu zeh — muttar litten lo apillu samuk lachasheka bistam belo qetzitza, deatu bekol paam vepaam yiqtzotz immo. Veyesh mattirin apillu bedabar sheen qitzbato yadua litten lo beHashem beshabbat o qodem leken ap al pi shello yukal legomrah qodem hashshabbat, shekkeshennoten lo beereb shabbat, im eno yakol legomrah mibbeod yom — hare zeh nireh keillu noten lo al menat sheyyigmor beshabbat, kevan shennoten lo samuk leshabbat vehu eno yakol legomrah mibbeod yom, abal bachamishi kevan sheeno samuk leshabbat — en nireh kenoten lo al menat laasot gam beshabbat, veim hannokri yaaseh meatzmo beshabbat — en bekak kelum, shellehashlim qabbelanuto hu oseh, veeno nireh kishlucho shel hayyisrael, ella beshaa shemmeqabbel haqqibbolet, sheaz ap im hayyisrael qotzetz lo damim — hare zeh nireh kishlucho shel yisrael, vekevan shennoten lo rachoq miyyom hashshabbat, ap im hu nireh az kishlucho, mikkol maqom en nireh keillu sholecho laasot beshabbat, ella im ken noten lo samuk leshabbat. Veken iqqar. (Umah sheanu machamirim gabbe shilluach iggeret kisbara harishona kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"z, hattaam hu, lepi shekkesheshsholecho badderek im iggeret sheyyolikenna limchoz cheptzo — nireh keillu omer lo lelek bekol yom apillu beshabbat ad sheyyaggia limchoz cheptzo, ulepikak tzarik sheyyihyeh yakol lehaggia lesham qodem hashshabbat ap al pi shemmeshallecho harbeh yamim qodem hashshabbat):

Umikkol maqom, im roeh oto oseh melakto beshabbat — tzarik lomar lo shello yaaseh, ap al pi shennatan lo be' beshabbat, ap al pi shehaya yakol legomrah kebar qodem hashshabbat (lepi shekkeshehayyisrael roehu beshabbat oseq bimlakto veshoteq lo — azay mebin hannokri shebbeshabbat hu noach lo lehayyisrael, umitkavven laasot bishbilo, mah sheen ken kesheeno roehu hu mitkavven lehashlim qabbelanuto):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello qatzatz lo sakar, vaapillu oseh betobat hanaa sheddino keqatzatz lo sakar leinyan litten lo apillu beereb shabbat, mikkol maqom kesheroehu oseh beshabbat — tzarik limchot beyado (dekevan deen dato semuka leqabbel sakar bead melakto — hare hu mitkavven bishbil hayyisrael, keshehu mebin middaat hayyisrael sheeseq zeh noach lo). Abal im qatzatz lo sakar — (hare hu mitkavven baasiyyato beshabbat kede leqabbel sekaro, velo bishbil hayyisrael ap sheroehu veshoteq lo, ulepikak) en tzarik limchot beyado kelal. Umikkol maqom, im hammelaka naaset beparhesya umepursam larabbim shehi shel yisrael — tzarik limchot, mippene marit haayin, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"d. Lepikak, hachaluqim shellanu bimdinot ellu shehem nikkarim shehem shel yisrael, keshemmekabbesan hannokri beshabbat al gabbe hannahar — tzarik limchot, mippene marit haayin, sheyyomru shebbeshabbat netanam lo lekabbesan. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla muttar littenam lo apillu beereb shabbat, veen chosheshim shemma yekabbesen beshabbat beparhesya:

Vekol zeh keshehammelaka naaset bachapatzim shel yisrael, kegon kelim shel yisrael shebbeyad hakkobes, veorot leabbedan o leratztzean litpor mehem minalim, vechutin leerog mehem beged. Abal im hayyisrael lo natan lo kelum, ella hannokri toper minalim meorot shello veoreg beged mechutin shello bebayit shello, ap al pi sheroehu oseh otah beshabbat — eno tzarik lomar lo kelum ap al pi shello qatzatz lo sakar, im eno oseh beparhesya, o sheen mepursam larabbim sheoseh bishbil hayyisrael, lepi sheadayin lo niqra shemo alehem, sheim yirtzeh hannokri yimkor otam leacher, veyaaseh lo acherim. Veap lekattechilla muttar letzavvot et hannokri laasotam, apillu beereb shabbat samuk lachasheka, raq shello yomru lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat:

Veken im hannokri meelayv belo amirat yisrael oseh melaka beshabbat mishshello, apillu bebet yisrael, bishbil yisrael, kegon shemmabir medura meetzim shello bishbil sheyyitchammem hayyisrael kenegdah, o shemmadliq ner shello bishbil sheyyishtammesh yisrael leorah — en tzarik limchot beyado, dekevan shehu oseh meelayv — bevadday hu oseh letobat atzmo, sheyyodea shello yapsid, ubevadday yeqabbel tobat hanaa mehayyisrael keneged zeh. Abal im mabir etzim shel hayyisrael, umadliq ner hayyisrael, ap al pi shemmikkevan sheoseh meelayv bevadday dato al tobat hanaa sheyyeqabbel mehayyisrael, mikkol maqom kevan shehannokri haya tzarik littol reshut mittechilla mehayyisrael im yabir etzayv veyadliq nero beshabbat, vehu oseh ken middaat atzmo, vehayyisrael roehu veshoteq lo, im ken mebin hannokri middaat hayyisrael shezzeh noach lo, umitkavven hu baasiyyato bishbil hayyisrael, lepikak tzarik limchot beyado, apillu shello bebet yisrael. Vaapillu im mabir meetzim shello, umadliq minner shello, sheen tzarik limchot beyado, mikkol maqom asur lo lehanot beshabbat mehanner vehammedura shehibir bishbilo, lepi sheim yeheneh gupo mimmenna beshabbat — nimtza sheiqqar hammelaka naaset bishbilo beshabbat, sheap shehannokri mitkavven letobat atzmo, mikkol maqom iqqar asiyyat melakto hi sheyyeheneh gup hayyisrael mimmenna beshabbat, sheim lo hanaat gup hayyisrael mimmenna beshabbat — lo haya oseh otah kelal beshabbat, vekevan sheiqqar asiyyat hammelaka hi bishbilo — yesh ligzor gezera shemma yomar lo laasot lo beshabbat im yihyeh muttar lo lehanot mimmenna keshennaaset bishbilo:

Abal nokri sheasa leyisrael keli beshabbat beqabbelanut, sheqqibbel meereb shabbat veqatzatz lo sakar — muttar lo lehanot mimmennu beshabbat atzmah, kevan shehannokri asaa letobat atzmo, lehashlim peullato uleqabbel sekaro, velo nitkavven bishbil sheyyehaneh mimmennu hayyisrael beshabbat atzmah, sheap im lo yehaneh mimmennu beshabbat atzmah lo yimmana hannokri measot melakto beshabbat, veim ken en leesor lo lehanot mimmah sheasa hannokri letobat atzmo, lepi sheap im yihyeh muttar lo lehanot mimmenna lo yabo lomar lannokri sheyyaaseh lo, kevan sheen mattirim lo ella keshemmitkavven hannokri letobat atzmo velo keshemmitkavven bishbil yisrael. Veyesh oserim lehishtammesh bikli hannigmar beshabbat beyad nokri, vegam bemotzae shabbat tzarik lehamtin bikde sheyyeasu, dehaynu keshiur shahut sheshshaha hannokri beeseq asiyyat hakkeli beshabbat, kede shello yehaneh mimmeleket shabbat. Veken yesh linhog lekattechilla, im lo shetztzarik elayv hakkeli beshabbat, sheaz yesh lehaqel. Veim nistappeq shemma nigmar hakkeli beereb shabbat — yesh lehaqel bekol inyan, kevan sheyyesh mattirin legamre. (Veim nigmar beyom tob a' — muttar belel yom tob b' bikde sheyyeasu, ayyen simman tqt"v). Veim gamar hannokri tepirat minalim meereb shabbat, raq shettiqqenam vehecheliqam beshabbat — muttar lelobsham bo bayyom ledibre hakkol, shehare eno neheneh bilbishato mimmeleket hashshabbat ella mimmeleket hachol, shehare haya yakol lelobsham belo tiqqun zeh. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

Vekol zeh bekelim sheasa leyisrael, abal nokri haoseh al hammiqqach limkor lekol mi sheyyizdammen lo, im hi ir sherubbah nokrim — muttar liqqach mimmennu beshabbat behaqqapa belo pissuq damim, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shk"g. Umuttar lelobsham bo bayyom, ap al pi sheyyadua sheasaan beshabbat, dekevan sherob hair hem nokrim — min hassetam asaan al daat nokrim, shekkol haoseh al daat harob hu oseh. Veken haddin beyom tob. Veap sheyyesh lehachamir benolad beyom tob kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ttz"h, mikkol maqom kan en bo mishshum nolad, hoil vehu dabar sheggemaro bide adam, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheshshiggeran hannokri o hebian beatzmo lebet hayyisrael. Abal asur lishloach etzlo littol kelim mibbeto (beshabbat) apillu al yede nokri, ap al pi shennigmeru meereb shabbat, lepi sheen mebiim kelim mibbet haumman kelal apillu bechullo shel moed, ella im ken hen letzorek hammoed, ap al pi shennigmeru qodem hammoed, mippene marit haayin, sheyyomru shebbammoed natan lo letaqqenam, uletzorek hammoed lo chasheshu lemarit haayin bammoed shehu qal, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tql"h, abal kan bashabbat (ap al pi shennigmeru meereb shabbat) o yom tob, apillu letzorek shabbat veyom tob asur littol mibbet haumman lebet yisrael, apillu mibbayit lebayit bechatzer achat, ella im ken shehannokri eno umman kelal, ella hu chenvani halloqeach mehaummanim umoker laacherim, sheaz muttar liqqach etzlo apillu bebeto o bachanuto, ulehabi lebet yisrael apillu derek harechob, im hi ir hamorebet:

Muttar liptoach mayim leginna, dehaynu laasot neger qatan missepat hammayan lagginna samuk lachasheka, vehammayim nimshakim veholekim lagginna kol hashshabbat kullah umashqim et hazzeraim, ap al pi shehammashqeh beshabbat chayyab. Veken muttar lehanniach qilor abeh al haayin lirpua veispelanit al gabbe hammakka, vehem mitrappeim veholekim kol hashshabbat kullah, ap al pi shebbeshabbat asur lehannicham, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"ch. Veken muttar liton qorot bet habbad al gabbe hazzetim veiggule haggat al gabbe haanabim samuk lachasheka, vehem nischatim veholekim kol hashshabbat kullah, ap al pi shehassochet beshabbat chayyab. Umikkol maqom, hashshemen vehayyayin hayyotze mehem mishshechasheka — asur, kedin mashqin shezzabu mealehem beshabbat, shehem asurim bo bayyom, mishshum gezera shemma yabo lischot beyadayim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"k. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehitin alehem samuk lachasheka mammash, abal im hitin alehem mibbeod hayyom gadol beinyan shennitrassequ mechamat hatteina qodem shechasheka — muttarin hashshemen vehayyayin hayyotze mehem kol hashshabbat kullah, shekkan en ligzor shemma yabo lesochotam beyadayim, lepi sheap im yischatem lo yaaseh issur min hattora ella middibre soperim, kevan shekkebar hem merussaqim, vehaya hammashqeh zab mehem meelayv belo teinat haqqora vehaiggulim ubelo sechita beyadayim, ella sheal yede hatteina vehassechita hu memaher latzet. Veken habboser vehammelilot sherisseqan mibbeod yom — muttarin hammashqin hayyotzein mehen beshabbat:

Muttar litten chittim letok rechayim shel mayim samuk lachasheka, vehem nitchanot kol hashshabbat kulla, veap al pi sheharechayim hen shel yisrael, veen chosheshin lehashmaat qol harechayim beshabbat, shello yomru rechayim shel peloni tochanot beshabbat, lepi shehakkol yodeim sheharechayim tochanot meatzman, velo yabou lechoshdo shebbeshabbat natan hachittim larechayim. Veyesh choleqim al zeh veoserin berechayim ubekol maqom sheyyesh hashmaat qol keshehammelaka naaset meeleha beshabbat, mippene shehu zilzul shabbat, sheyyomru shebbeshabbat hitchil hammelaka, ella im ken shehammelaka naaset birshut nokri, veen shem hayyisrael niqra aleha kelal, kegon litten chittim letok rechayim shel nokri mibbeod yom, o shennoten lehannokri mibbeod yom, vehannokri notenan larechayim shello apillu beshabbat im qatzatz lo sakar kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ubilbad shello yaamod yisrael etzlo beshabbat leshomro shello yignob, mippene marit haayin, sheyyomru shehu shelucho shel yisrael haomed alayv, ella im ken yesh chashash hepsed merubbeh, sheaz en chosheshim lemarit ayin kazeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"d. Vekol shekken im hashshaa tzerika lekak, kegon shehu samuk lepesach, vetzarik hayyisrael lishmor harechayim shello yabou sham mayim. Uleinyan halaka, bemaqom sheen sham minhag — yesh lehachamir kisbara haacharona, ella im ken yesh sham hepsed, sheaz yesh lismok al sebara harishona:

Umikkol maqom, muttar lehaamid meereb shabbat zug hamqashqesh leshaot asuy al yede mishqolet, ap al pi shemmashmia qol beshabbat — lo yabou lomar sheheemido beshabbat veabar al gezerat chakamim sheaseru lehashmia qol beshabbat (bikli hamyuchad lekak) kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"ch, lepi shehakkol yodeim sheddarko lehaamido meetmol, shekken hu darko leolam lehaamido bekol yom al yom shelleacharayv:

Lo yetze adam lirshut harabbim samuk lachasheka vechepetz beyado, gezera shemma yishkach lehasir hachepetz miyyado lehatznio ad leachar shechasheka, veaz yizkor shehachepetz beyado, veyishkach shehu shabbat veyetze gam ken im hachepetz mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, o yaabirennu d' ammot birshut harabbim, o yaknisennu mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid. Abal im lo haya nizkar mehachepetz mishshechasheka — lo haya ober al issur shel tora, shello osra tora ella meleket machashebet, dehaynu shehu mechashsheb umitkavven laasiyyat melaka, veshigegato shemmebi aleha chattat hi, sheeno yodea shehayyom shabbat, o sheeno yodea shemmelaka zo asura:

Abal muttar latzet lirshut harabbim samuk lachasheka bemachat hattechuba lo bebigdo, vekol kayyotze bazeh beinyan sheim haya yotze bo beshabbat haya patur min hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"a. Veap shehu asur beshabbat miggezerat chakamim, mikkol maqom samuk lachasheka lo gazeru al zeh, sheen gozerin gezera ligzera. Lepikak bizman hazzeh sheppashat hamminhag kehaomerin sheakshav en lanu reshut harabbim gemura ella karmelit kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shm"h — en issur kelal latzet samuk lachasheka apillu bechepetz shebbeyado, shehare issur hahotzaa bekarmelit eno ella gezera middibrehem, veen gozerin gezera ligzera:

Umuttar latzet apillu birshut harabbim gemura bitpillin shebberosho (veshebbizroo) samuk lachasheka, veen chosheshim shemma yishkach millahasiran ad leachar shettechshak, veaz shemma yitztarek lippanot veyasir hattepillin merosho (uzeroo) veyoliken beyado lehatznian, veyishkach shehu shabbat veyaabiren d' ammot birshut harabbim, dekevan sheasur lehassiach daat mittepillin linhog qallut rosh keshehu labush bahen, kemo shennitbaer besimman k"ch, mittok kak hu nizkar alehen tadir, visalleqen qodem shettechshak:

Mitzva al kol adam sheyyemashmesh bibgadayv ereb shabbat samuk lachasheka, shello yihyeh bahem dabar sheasur latzet bo beshabbat, apillu leminhagenu kehaomerim sheen lanu akshav reshut harabbim gemura. Veyattir chagoro, veyiqqach kol hattaluy bo:
